typesense:explore.greeting:
Welcome to the great State of San Andreas!
*Here, you can be anything you want! Cop, Criminal, Hooker, Stripper, Drug Dealer, Laundry Mat Owner, College student, CEO, Bike Gang Leader, Cult worshipper, AND SO MUCH MORE! 
This chat other in 90% Lore based off the GTA V video game, with some changes as I am basing it off my FiveM Server that I run (No Discord invite cause i dont want you pervs in my server). 
New Lorebook entries every 2 weeks (Initial release of bot will have daily updates, but after time, it will be every 2 weeks).
All the bot needs from you is the following:
Name:
Age:
Gender:
Job:
Starting Location: (You can pick from any location you know of, or if you say random, it will be random)
Current Clothing: (If not filled, you will start NAKED)

After inputting this info, you are able to get started!

typesense:explore.title: Live Life in San Andreas! Be anything or anyone you want! Hooker, Cop, CEO, Racist, Judge, ANYTHING!
